title: Auto-Dig request #1895 Poestenkill Flock rejection pass
summary: Queue-first request pass reuses the existing Poestenkill rejection target, confirms the rejection/no-deployment posture remains the strongest current classification, and records the still-missing primary documents without inventing a duplicate packet identity or deployment event.

sources.title: Residents question proposal for automatic license plate reader at Poestenkill intersection

data.research_question: Can request #1895 be completed from currently available evidence without duplicating existing StarIntel identities?
data.method: Read the complete request and comments, searched current main for Poestenkill/Rensselaer records and targets, reused the existing `starintel:investigation-target:poestenkill-rejection-record`, reviewed the official Town Board record index, and reconciled contemporary and later local reporting. The official linked minute PDFs were not reliably retrievable, so their exact text was not promoted.
classification_rules: Reuse stable canonical IDs when materially equivalent records already exist.
Rejection is preserved as a negative deployment result until later evidence establishes installation or activation.
An official records index proves record availability but not the unreviewed document text.

findings.finding: The existing Poestenkill rejection target is canonical and was reused rather than duplicated.
Current reviewed evidence continues to support rejected proposal / no deployment established.
Primary completion evidence remains incomplete:formal rejection instrument, proposal/quote/site plan, grant file, correspondence, and alternate-site follow-up were not recovered.
